name: h4 · Model calls
description: The twin's model calls from this stack's traces: spend, calls, failures, latency, and tokens, over the range and by model over time. Grafana's h4-runtime holds the meter, its ceilings, the kill switch, and the degraded causes.

widgets.name: Spend over the range
widgets.description: Spend over the dashboard's range, in USD: the sum of the gateway's own price for every model call (config/prices.yaml; 0 for local calls), as Langfuse holds it. The authoritative spend and the meter's ceilings, prod's $5.00 a day and $20.00 a month and the laptop's $2.00-a-day fallback sub-budget (config/budgets.yaml), are Grafana's "Spend" row.

widgets.name: Model calls over the range
widgets.description: Model calls over the dashboard's range, in calls: every provider attempt, a fallback's and a retry's included, each a generation. Grafana's "Request count" counts requests instead, one for each hello or turn.

widgets.name: Failed model calls over the range
widgets.description: Failed model calls over the dashboard's range, in calls: provider attempts whose span ended in error (a timeout, a refusal, the provider down); a failed local call is usually followed by the fallback's. Grafana's "Error rate" shows the requests that failed.

widgets.name: Model latency p95 over the range
widgets.description: The 95th percentile of the model calls' latency over the dashboard's range, in milliseconds, from the call's start to its end at the gateway. Grafana's "Provider latency p95" is the same measure from the gateway's metrics.

widgets.name: Spend by model
widgets.description: Spend by model over time, in USD: the gateway's own price for each model call (config/prices.yaml; 0 for local calls). On the laptop, a paid model's bar is the fallback's spend. The authoritative spend and the meter's ceilings, prod's $5.00 a day and $20.00 a month and the laptop's $2.00-a-day fallback sub-budget (config/budgets.yaml), are Grafana's "Spend" row; Grafana's "Cost by provider and attribution" splits it by attribution.

widgets.name: Model calls by model
widgets.description: Model calls by model over time, in calls. Each model names its route: on the laptop, the local model is the local tier and claude-haiku-5-5 its paid fallback, so the paid bar's share is the fallback's share; on dev, metered-test is the synthetic spend. Grafana's "Answered locally" gives the turns' share.

widgets.name: Model latency p50 by model
widgets.description: The median latency of the model calls by model over time, in milliseconds, from the call's start to its end at the gateway.

widgets.name: Model latency p95 by model
widgets.description: The 95th percentile of the model calls' latency by model over time, in milliseconds. Grafana's "Provider latency p95" is the same measure from the gateway's metrics.

widgets.name: Failed model calls by model
widgets.description: Failed model calls by model over time, in calls: attempts whose span ended in error. Langfuse's tracing table, filtered to the level ERROR, opens each one with its error type.

widgets.name: Tokens by model
widgets.description: Tokens by model over time, input and output together, in tokens. Grafana's "Tokens by provider" splits them by type.
